Thus the measure may be replaced by its symmetrization without changing gain, even if W is not even. IntegralW=1 and exclusive event R give count2R, energy(A+epsilon)R and momentum epsilon*R*n/c. Change variables K=K0+B*mu in each daughter term. First contributes q(x)/B, second q(-x)/B; even law gives2q(x)/B. Azimuth marginal alone suffices for this scalar energy law.

Expand(1-mu^2)(a0+a1*mu^2+a2*mu^4)=c0+c2*mu^2+c4*mu^4+c6*mu^6. Integrating2q(x)x^k on each bin yields the stated G expression. Telescoping the partition gives sumG0=2,sumG1=0,sumG2=2m2. K0G0+BG1 is exact bin kinetic gain; midpoint count weighting does not preserve this in general.

For(a0,a1,a2)=(1411/10000,-1/4,33/25), Z=14297/52500 and integral mu^2 numerator=24377/262500, so m2=24377/71485. The quadratic vertex lies at z=25/264 in[0,1] and its value is170627/1320000>0, proving selected-law nonnegativity.

The finite geometric identity (1-rx)^-1=sum0toN(r*x)^k+(r*x)^(N+1)/(1-rx) is pointwise. Nonnegative W gives remainder in[r^(N+1)m_(2N+2),r^(N+1)m_(2N+2)/(1-r)]. Multiplication by negative-D reverses endpoints and produces stated LN/UN and width.

Let Mj=E[x^j]. SN+1=SN+r^(N+1)M_(N+1). Substitution gives L_(N+1)-LN=D*r^(N+2)*(M_(N+1)-M_(N+2))/(1-r)>=0 and UN-U_(N+1)=D*r^(N+2)*M_(N+2)>=0. Width_(N+1)<=r*width_N follows from0<=x<=1, including zero-width cases without dividing by a zero moment.
